diagnosis: In this Robyn async application, the route verifies that the incoming request has a valid authentication token via request.identity, but never verifies that the authenticated user is a member of the workspace_id in the path parameters. An authenticated user can inspect real-time activity and revenue analytics stored in the Rust runtime cache for any workspace.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/workspaces/ws_target_corp_991/realtime-analytics HTTP/1.1
Host: robyn-app.internal.cloud
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
